The ferns ( Polypodiopsida or Polypodiophyta ) are a group of vascular plants ( land plants with vascular tissues such as xylem and phloem ) that reproduce via spores and have neither seeds nor flowers . They differ from non-vascular plants ( mosses , hornworts and liverworts ) by having specialized transport bundles that conduct water and nutrients from and to the roots , as well as life cycles in which the branched sporophyte is the dominant phase.
